description: She wears a dark moss-green woven court gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a floor-length open-front skirt over a pale cream underdress. Narrow gold-tan knotwork borders outline the neckline, bodice, cuffs, front edges and hem. A woven green-and-gold belt closes with a round metal clasp, while a dark blue-green plaid shawl drapes over the shoulders and forearms, held by two round brooches. Brown leather lace-up footwear shows beneath the hem. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
